integrity: Reproducible finite enumeration is included but not an infinite proof. The all-parameter result follows from a structural path/cycle argument and labelled occupancy counting. Publication priority is not independently verified.
scientific_limitations: Finite labelled domains with named exact linear-order successor relations; requires each used arc to have support exceeding half the relations. No classification of arbitrary binary relations, weak quorums or infinite order types. Specialised older consensus literature may contain an equivalent implication.
title: Strict-quorum rigidity and exact finite-model diversity for multiple successor orders
